name: JA Jalbert Pro Backpack
description: A tournament-day backpack built for players who carry more than one paddle. Dedicated padded paddle sleeves sit alongside a ventilated shoe compartment and an insulated side pocket for drinks, so gear, shoes, and hydration never mix in transit.
care_instructions: Spot clean the exterior with a damp cloth and mild soap; do not machine wash. Air dry fully before storing paddles inside to avoid trapped moisture.
